story.title: Story 5: Attach And Import Existing PI Sessions

result.planSummary: Implemented Story 5 by adding PI active-path import resolution, attach/import orchestration that reuses canonical capture flow, partial-import repair-state handling, and a dedicated import-service test suite covering attach, branching, metadata, turn reconstruction, preview, and live-capture continuation.

changedFiles.reason: Adds active-path resolution for PI session files, including explicit multi-leaf ambiguity detection and importable message extraction.
Adds attach/import orchestration, canonical imported capture, import metadata recording, partial-import repair-state handling, and dry-run preview support.

Adds Story 5 coverage for attach/import success, empty attach, duplicate conflicts, branch-path handling, canonical message preservation, import metadata, turn reconstruction, partial imports, live-capture continuation, preview, and issue ordering.

findingsFixed: Implemented active-path selection so raw branched PI sessions require an explicit leaf or fail with IMPORT_PATH_AMBIGUOUS instead of importing an arbitrary branch.
Ensured imported history flows through the canonical capture path, preserves PI metadata/typed parts, and records import source range plus active-path metadata.
Marked partial imports as repair_needed at both thread and imported-turn level so incomplete attach state is visible before later repair work.
findingsSurfaced: `npm run test:integration` still reports no integration tests found, so attach/import coverage is unit-level only right now.

result.recommendedNextStep: Run story verification review on the new import-service behavior, then wire `/lh-attach` command-surface coverage in the later command-focused story if that surface is next.
